integrity: The proof uses an explicit odds-coordinate reduction and convexity in the Rényi/Tsallis order parameter. Finite numerical checks are reported only as stress tests and are not used as proof. The q=1 endpoint and q>2 sharpness input are attributed to the published source.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is only for two Bernoulli summands and coordinatewise monotonicity. It does not establish the general-n Hillion–Johnson conjecture or any joint-concavity statement. Full text of arXiv:2609.27433 was not available through the bounded public retrieval route, so an unobserved discussion there remains a literature risk.
title: Exact Rényi–Tsallis monotonicity threshold for two Bernoulli sums
